When the button in the control panel for the heated rear windscreen is pressed, the defrosting function for one of the door mirrors is not working.

The defrosting of the door mirrors is activated using the same switch in the control panel as for the defrosting of the heated rear windscreen. Having received the defrosting command, the body computer node sends the signal, via the VAN CAR2, to the door nodes which manage the defrosting of the door mirrors.The networks go on stand-by 30 mins after the engine has been switched off. This makes it impossible to carry out the fault diagnosis. If a diagnostic session has to be opened, start up the engine to reawaken the networks
